description: This Java class defines a request to obtain the source route (hops) for a Zigbee device identified by its EUI-64 address, including logic to traverse parent devices and assemble the route.

classes.name: GetSourceRouteRequest
classes.description: A request class that retrieves the source route for a Zigbee device based on its EUI-64 address, by traversing device parent-child relationships and sending the route as a response.

methods.name: GetSourceRouteRequest
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the request with request ID and device EUI-64.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the operation to gather the source route hops by following parent devices and sends the route as a response.
